subject: HarborView expansion: multiproject orchestration & key distribution
messages:
From: Claire Adams <claire.adams@harborview.com>
To: soojin.lee@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Cc: devops@harborview.com, procure@harborview.com
Date: Mon, 10 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + expansion conversation

Thanks for the call today — Claire here. Quick recap and ask: HarborView wants to add three new app teams (Patient Intake, Claims Analyzer, Internal Automation) under our existing account for the 2028–29 term.

Key asks: 
- Updated SOW that reflects 3 additional API keys (project-scoped), expected peak throughput per team (est. 120 reqs/s), and a shared dedicated pool for burst.
- Any term changes needed for the extra capacity and a proposed uplift (we have budget approval subject to final numbers).
- A short rollout plan so DevOps can automate key provisioning and rotate keys on a 90-day cadence.

Can you send a draft SOW and a deployment playbook we can share with our internal security and procurement teams?

Thanks,
Claire
Director, Platform Integrations
HarborView Health
From: soojin.lee@redwood.com
To: Claire Adams <claire.adams@harborview.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 10 Jun 2028 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + expansion conversation

Claire — great to hear this is moving forward. Attaching a first-draft playbook and a deployment plan for review. High-level notes below; I'll follow up with a short call invite for Friday to walk through the SOW.

Summary of what we'll include: 
- SOW: lists three additional project keys, dedicated pool sizing (recommend 1x p4d-equivalent capacity for burst; see estimate table in MAV-Deployment-Plan-v2.pdf).
- Pricing: one-time amendment to committed capacity (pro-rated) + incremental per-token uplift above committed threshold. We can provide two tiered uplift options (conservative and aggressive).
- Rollout: staged provisioning across teams — pilot (Patient Intake), then Claims Analyzer, then Internal Automation. Each stage includes smoke tests and KMS key rotation schedule.
- Security: template answers for your procurement/security questionnaire; we'll include audit log paths and retention options.

Attachments: [Attachment: MAV-Deployment-Plan-v2.pdf (11KB)], [Attachment: HarborView_SOW_Draft.docx (28KB)]

Next steps: 
1) Review SOW + deployment plan with your procurement/security.
2) Provide expected go-live window for each app (week ranges).
3) Confirm whether HarborView prefers per-project keys or environment-scoped keys (we usually recommend project-scoped for least privilege).

Ben and Laura are looped in for pricing and activation timelines.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: ben.carter@redwood.com
To: soojin.lee@redwood.com, Claire Adams <claire.adams@harborview.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 11 Jun 2028 09:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + expansion conversation

Claire — thanks, quick pricing sketch while you review the doc: 
- Option A (Conservative): add 3 project keys, +40% reserved capacity (pro-rated to renewal date), estimated delta $13,200/month. Includes standard support and 99.9% uptime SLA.
- Option B (Aggressive): add 3 project keys, +80% reserved capacity with burst buffer, estimated delta $24,500/month. Includes 24x7 escalation and 1 guaranteed burst node pool.

We can lock rates for 12 months if you re-up at current committed level. If you confirm target go-live windows by Thurs 14th, I can run a firm quote and prepare an addendum.

Laura — can you confirm lead time for API key provisioning and whether we should use a staged key rotation (90-day) or customer-managed rotation?

Thanks,
Ben
From: laura.bennett@redwood.com
To: ben.carter@redwood.com, soojin.lee@redwood.com, Claire Adams <claire.adams@harborview.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Jun 2028 10:55:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + expansion conversation

Claire — we typically provision project-scoped keys and integrate with your KMS for rotation. Lead times: 
- Standard provisioning for 3 keys: 24 hours after contract amendment is signed.
- Staged rollout (pilot -> team2 -> team3): provisioning happens per-stage and we hand off a small automation script (Terraform/Ansible snippet) to your DevOps.

Rotation options: 
- Option 1: Redwood-managed rotation (90-day cadence) — low lift for your team, we handle key updates via a secure endpoint.
- Option 2: Customer-managed rotation — you own lifecycle; we provide rotation API and docs.

I can send the automation snippets and a sample playbook. If procurement needs any evidence items (SOC2 artifact, encryption matrix), see the attached SOW and I'll also drop a separate email to security with links.

—Laura
From: Claire Adams <claire.adams@harborview.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com, soojin.lee@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 13 Jun 2028 08:33:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + expansion conversation

Thanks all — procurement asked for two clarifications before internal approval: 
1) Can you specify exact SLA uplift for Option B (we need an explicit latency target for peak 95th percentile)?
2) For billing alignment: can you pro-rate capacity changes to the renewal anniversary instead of charging immediately?

We'd like to pilot Patient Intake the week of 7/9, Claims Analyzer 7/23, and Internal Automation 8/6, subject to contract timing. If you can confirm provisioning lead times and pro-rating, procurement will fast-track the amendment.

Claire
From: soojin.lee@redwood.com
To: Claire Adams <claire.adams@harborview.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 15 Jun 2028 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + expansion conversation

Claire — short answers below and a follow-up call invite (15-min) for tomorrow to finalize details: 

1) SLA for Option B: we can guarantee 95th-percentile p50/p95 latency targets of 60ms/180ms for interactive workloads at the specified peak with the burst pool active; formal SLA language to be added to the SOW. This includes automatic fallback to compatible model variants if capacity constrained.

2) Billing: we can pro-rate capacity increases to the renewal anniversary date. Practically: we will provision keys and enable the burst pool immediately for pilot, charge a pro-rated commit for the remainder of the current billing cycle, and reconcile at renewal with an annual true-up (or you may opt to pay the full uplift immediately; we'll honor whichever you prefer).

Action items: 
- Ben to submit firm quote addendum by EOD Mon 6/18.
- Laura to share provisioning snippets and the sample playbook (today).
- Claire to confirm go-live windows formally in reply to this thread.

Attachments re-sent: [Attachment: MAV-Deployment-Plan-v2.pdf], [Attachment: HarborView_SOW_Draft.docx]

Appreciate the quick turnaround — we'll get the addendum ready for procurement.

Best,
Soojin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
